description: Resume on gpt-5.6-luna after the Session spent on gpt-5.6-terra and, earlier, on luna: the host starts the adapter with what the Session has spent on each Model so far (launch.json `spent`). The resumed thread's tokenUsage `total` still counts every earlier turn, on whatever Model, so the adapter reports luna's running total as what the host had on luna plus this launch's share of the thread total (the total less what it was before this launch's first request, `total - last` at the first report); terra's tokens are never priced on luna. Synthesised from the codex app-server JSON schema generated by codex-cli 0.144.1 (`codex app-server generate-json-schema`), not captured from a live run: whether a resumed thread's `total` counts earlier launches is unverified, and the adapter is right either way. Replace with a capture (see crates/codex-adapter/README.md).
